research.searchCoverage: Official MailerSend API, authentication, company identity and dated security coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current credible unresolved security issue identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

breach.coverage: Bounded official-source review; no current unresolved credible issue identified; no breach-free claim.

research.searchCoverage: Official MailerSend API, authentication, company identity and dated security coverage reviewed on 2026-09-13. No current credible unresolved security issue identified; this is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: MailerSend documents revoking leaked API tokens and generating replacements as credential-leak remediation.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only probe uses documented minimum limit=10 for GET /v1/domains.
Raw provider JSON is preserved under the strict data wrapper; pagination is caller controlled. Optional verified filter is forwarded.
MailerSend has no catalog-of-endpoints API; GET /v1/domains?limit=10 is the documented authenticated resource overview.
Official GET /v1/messages accepts page, limit, and domain_id. Composio date_from/date_to are forwarded as query params.
Official GET /v1/recipients accepts domain_id, page, and limit. Composio search and list_id are forwarded as query params.
Declarative GET /v1/sms-activity; status arrays are sent as repeated status[] query parameters.

domains.list.title: Get sending domains
domains.list.description: Retrieve a paginated list of sending domains, optionally filtered by verification status.

verified.description: Filter by verification status (true verified, false unverified, omit for all).

domains.get.title: Get domain
domains.get.description: Retrieve one sending domain, including verification (DKIM, SPF, MX, tracking) and settings.

domain_id.description: Unique identifier of the sending domain.

domains.create.title: Create sending domain
domains.create.description: Add a sending domain. The name must be unique, lowercase, available, and resolvable.

name.description: Fully qualified domain name to add for sending emails.

return_path_subdomain.description: Alphanumeric subdomain for return path, e.g. rp.

custom_tracking_subdomain.description: Alphanumeric subdomain for click/open tracking, e.g. track.

inbound_routing_subdomain.description: Alphanumeric subdomain for inbound routing, e.g. inbound.

domains.recipients.list.title: List domain recipients
domains.recipients.list.description: List recipients recorded for a sending domain with optional pagination.

domain_id.description: ID of the domain whose recipients to list.

smtp_users.list.title: Get SMTP users
smtp_users.list.description: List SMTP users for a sending domain with optional pagination.

domain_id.description: Domain ID that scopes the SMTP users.

smtp_users.create.title: Create SMTP user
smtp_users.create.description: Create an SMTP user on a domain. The plaintext password is returned only once.

domain_id.description: ID of the domain to associate with this SMTP user.

name.description: Display name for the SMTP user (max 50 characters).

enabled.description: Whether the SMTP user should be enabled. Defaults to true.

tokens.list.title: Get API tokens
tokens.list.description: List API tokens (id, name, status, scopes). Requires the tokens_full scope. Token values are never returned.

tokens.create.title: Create API token
tokens.create.description: Create an API token for a domain. The token value is returned only once and cannot be retrieved later.

name.description: Descriptive name for the token (max 50 characters).

domain_id.description: Domain ID to associate with this token.

scopes.description: Permission scopes to grant. Official scopes include: email_full, domains_read, domains_full, activity_read, activity_full, analytics_read, analytics_full, tokens_full, webhooks_full, templates_full, suppressions_read, suppressions_full, sms_full, sms_read, email_verification_read, email_verification_full, inbounds_full, recipients_read, recipients_full, sender_identity_read, sender_identity_full, users_read, users_full, smtp_users_read, smtp_users_full, dmarc_monitoring_read, dmarc_monitoring_full, blocklist_monitoring_read, blocklist_monitoring_full, whatsapp_full.

webhooks.list.title: List webhooks
webhooks.list.description: List webhooks for a domain. Official API requires domain_id.

domain_id.description: Domain ID whose webhooks to list.

webhooks.create.title: Create webhook
webhooks.create.description: Create a domain webhook. MailerSend pings the URL and requires a 2xx before saving. Official name max is 50 characters; url max is 191.

url.description: Callback URL that receives POST events (max 191 characters).

events.description: Events to subscribe to. Valid events include: activity.sent, activity.delivered, activity.soft_bounced, activity.hard_bounced, activity.deferred, activity.opened, activity.opened_unique, activity.clicked, activity.clicked_unique, activity.unsubscribed, activity.spam_complaint, activity.suppressed, activity.survey_opened, activity.survey_submitted, sender_identity.verified, maintenance.start, maintenance.end, inbound_forward.failed, inbound_message.rejected, email_single.verified, email_list.created, email_list.verified, bulk_email.completed, recipient.on_hold_added, recipient.on_hold_removed.

enabled.description: Whether the webhook is enabled immediately. Defaults to true.

domain_id.description: Domain ID to attach the webhook to.

webhooks.delete.title: Delete webhook
webhooks.delete.description: Delete a webhook. Successful deletion returns HTTP 204 with an empty body.

webhook_id.description: Unique identifier of the webhook to delete.

quota.get.title: Get API quota
quota.get.description: Retrieve remaining daily API quota and reset time. This endpoint does not count toward the quota.

resources.general.title: Get general API resources
resources.general.description: List sending domains as the account's primary API resources. MailerSend has no catalog-of-endpoints API; this is the documented authenticated resource overview (GET /v1/domains?limit=10).

identities.list.title: List sender identities
identities.list.description: List sender identities with optional domain or email filters and pagination.

domain_id.description: Filter identities belonging to this domain ID.

messages.list.title: Get sent messages
messages.list.description: List message resources created from Email API requests. Official filters are page, limit, and domain_id; date_from/date_to are forwarded as Composio ISO-8601 query params.

domain_id.description: Filter messages belonging to this domain ID.

date_from.description: Filter messages on or after this datetime (ISO 8601).

date_to.description: Filter messages on or before this datetime (ISO 8601).

recipients.list.title: Get email recipients
recipients.list.description: List email recipients. Official filters are domain_id, page, and limit; search and list_id are forwarded as Composio query params.

domain_id.description: Filter recipients belonging to this domain ID.

search.description: Search term for recipient email or name.

list_id.description: Filter recipients by mailing list ID when the account uses lists.

sms.activity.list.title: Get SMS activity
sms.activity.list.description: List SMS activity logs. Status filters are sent as repeated status[] query parameters.

sms_number_id.description: Filter by SMS phone number ID.

date_from.description: Unix timestamp (UTC) lower bound. Must be lower than date_to.

date_to.description: Unix timestamp (UTC) upper bound. Must be higher than date_from.

status.description: Filter by message status. Repeatable. Official values: processed, queued, sent, delivered, failed.

sms.inbounds.list.title: Get SMS inbounds
sms.inbounds.list.description: List SMS inbound routes, optionally filtered by SMS number or enabled status.

sms_number_id.description: Filter inbound routes by SMS number ID.

sms.messages.list.title: List SMS messages
sms.messages.list.description: List SMS messages sent through the MailerSend SMS API.

sms.numbers.list.title: Get SMS numbers
sms.numbers.list.description: List SMS phone numbers, optionally filtered by paused status.

paused.description: Filter paused (true) or active (false) numbers; omit for all.

sms.recipients.list.title: Get SMS recipients
sms.recipients.list.description: List SMS recipients, optionally filtered by SMS number ID and status.

sms_number_id.description: Filter recipients by SMS number ID.

templates.list.title: Get email templates
templates.list.description: List email templates, optionally filtered by domain ID.

domain_id.description: Filter templates belonging to this domain ID.

users.list.title: Get users
users.list.description: List users associated with the MailerSend account.
